lead: Flex layout: lays out a row (or a column) of things. The spacing comes from the theme style's scale and alignment is a prop, so no `className` or `style` is needed. The component has no margins of its own; `gap` sets all the spacing. For a page-level grid (widths in 24ths that change with the screen) use `Row` / `Col`, see [Grid](/grid).

toolbar.title: Spacer and wrap
toolbar.description: `Flex.Spacer` pushes what follows it to the other end; `wrap` moves what doesn't fit to the next line.

api.title: API Reference
api.spacer: `Flex.Spacer` takes no props: it fills the remaining space and pushes what follows it to the other end.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles define the spacing scale in `flex.css`: to make a theme style's spacing looser or tighter overall, change the scale there.
